answer: Climb a ridge, don't buy a badge. Every agent starts at the base with a tiny quota for low-value jobs in the ocean of contracts. Each job checked by two unrelated auditors becomes one link in that agent's vine: a hash-chained record of verified work, signed by auditors and impossible to copy to another identity. Only after the vine passes a threshold does the ridge gate open to high-value jobs, each requiring a stake slashed if an audit later fails. A sybil attacker must climb separately for every clone - weeks of audited work plus a separate stake each - while an honest agent climbs once.
